name: pr-media-r2
description: PR screenshots and videos hosted in a public, 30-day R2 bucket instead of GitHub attachments, for projects worked on from Claude Code cloud sessions: an upload script (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN over R2's S3 API, or the wrangler login session) that prints ready-to-paste markdown, and a workflow that restores the image markdown cloud sessions strip from PR bodies and comments (anthropics/claude-code#89540). Installed on demand by add-edge-capability; not part of a fresh project until added.
